title: FeatureLoop: Benchmarking Coding Agents under Evolving Requirements
abstract: arXiv:2610.35488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software development with coding agents often begins with a rough request that users refine after trying the implementation. Final correctness alone does not capture the repeated guidance this process requires. We introduce FeatureLoop, a benchmark of 61 human-reviewed tasks from 34 repositories across five primary programming languages and seven software forms. Each task follows one development goal in a persistent workspace through evolution feedback, which adds or clarifies requirements, and completion feedback, which reports failures of stated requirements. Cumulative executable checks track new behavior, repair, and preservation of earlier functionality. We evaluate 12 frontier models and find that the strongest completes 72.1% of tasks with both feedback types. translated_title: FeatureLoop：在需求不断演化下对编码智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 使用编码智能体进行软件开发通常始于一个粗略的请求，用户在尝试实现后会对其进行逐步完善。仅凭最终结果的正确性无法体现这一过程中所需的反复引导。我们提出了FeatureLoop，这是一个包含61个经人工审核任务的基准测试，任务来自34个代码仓库，涵盖五种主要编程语言和七种软件形态。每个任务在持久化工作区中围绕一个开发目标展开，通过演化反馈（增加或澄清需求）和完成反馈（报告已声明需求的失败情况）来推进。累积的可执行检查用于追踪新行为的实现、问题的修复以及早期功能的保留。我们评估了12个前沿模型，发现表现最强的模型在同时提供两类反馈的情况下完成了72.1%的任务。然而，纵观所有模型，观测到的失败阶段中仅有15.4%能在两次纠正性修订内恢复。进一步的分析揭示了修复不完整、功能回退以及模型特有的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FeatureLoop基准，通过演化反馈与完成反馈模拟真实开发中需求不断演进的过程，对61个任务上的12个前沿模型进行评估，发现最强模型仅完成72.1%的任务，且绝大多数失败阶段难以在两次纠正性修订内恢复。
en_tdlr: FeatureLoop is a benchmark that evaluates coding agents under continuously evolving requirements using evolution and completion feedback across 61 human-reviewed tasks, showing that the strongest of 12 frontier models completes only 72.1% of tasks and failed stages rarely recover within two corrective revisions.
